counterfactual_missing_items: Lack of waxing and waning course
No mention of large cell transformation
decisive_items: Numerous pink-purple dermal papules were present on the trunk and extremities, with preference for the extensor surfaces of the arms and legs.
Nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate (H&E stain)
T-cell receptor PCR: Matching clonal rearrangements identified in 3 skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample
response.rationale: R3 is the champion due to its comprehensive support from multiple raw spans, including clinical presentation, histopathological findings, and molecular tests, which are all consistent with Mycosis Fungoides. R4, on the other hand, lacks sufficient support and has fewer matching raw spans.

rejected.why: Insufficient support from raw spans and lack of distinctive features of Lymphomatoid Papulosis
